turns.user: I activated a 30-minute mobile ticket at 10:00 and transferred at 10:28.
turns.agent:
Under the 5 November 2026 snapshot, a transfer is allowed on covered lines if you make it within the 30-minute window. Since you transferred at 10:28, that is within the window after activating at 10:00. Validate the mobile ticket when you change lines (except when transferring between metro lines). If that transfer is onto your final line, you may finish that last ride after the 30 minutes have elapsed; the window doesn’t mean you must be off the vehicle by 10:30. BKK: 30-minute ticket

This is general guidance, not verification of your ticket or trip. If you tell me whether you changed onto a bus/tram or between metro lines, I can clarify the validation step.

turns.user: My last bus arrives at 10:48. Can I stay on that bus until the stop?
turns.agent:
Yes—if the transfer at 10:28 was onto your final bus, the snapshot says you may complete that last ride even after the 30-minute window ends at 10:30. So arriving at 10:48 is okay under that rule; you don’t have to get off at 10:30. You should have validated the mobile ticket when boarding/changing to that bus. BKK: 30-minute ticket

That’s guidance from the 5 November 2026 snapshot, not a live check or verification of your ticket.
